data.title: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI
data.description: Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora said AI is forcing companies to modernize roughly $1 trillion of aging cybersecurity infrastructure that isn’t equipped for attacks.
data.author: Alexa LoMonaco
